title: Eiffel Tower
text: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower in Paris, France. It was completed in 1889 as the entrance arch to the World's Fair.

title: Golden Gate Bridge
text: The Golden Gate Bridge is a suspension bridge in San Francisco. It opened to traffic in 1937.

title: Mount Everest
text: Mount Everest is Earth's highest mountain above sea level, with an official height of 8,849 metres.

title: K2
text: K2 is the second-highest mountain on Earth, with a height of 8,611 metres, on the China-Pakistan border.

title: Python (programming language)
text: Python is a programming language created by Guido van Rossum. It was first released in 1991.

title: Great Wall of China
text: The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications built over many centuries. Its total length is about 21,196 kilometres.
